title: Supplementary Data S11: within-band distribution of the exposure estimate and the split-half selection overlap, with its chance baseline

method.source: per-graph candidate files of the m=7 fanout sweep, 64 graphs per family
method.split: the 400 calibration traces are split into trace indices 0-199 and 200-399; each half gives an independent exposure estimate at K=200
method.chance_baseline: two independent uniform 50-subsets of a band of B candidates overlap in 50*50/B relays in expectation (hypergeometric mean). This is the baseline the observed overlap must be read against.
method.note: overlap is reported under RouteBand's own score, exposure times the forwarding factor, and under exposure alone, because the two differ materially.
